outline: This course will introduce common algorithms and analysis methods. The details include complexity analysis, set, priority queue, trees, sorting, searching, graph, dynamic programming, and so on.
schedule:
week 1-2: Complexity
week 3-5: Data structures
week 6-8: Divide and Conquer
week 9-11: Greedy algorithm
week 12-16: Dynamic programming
week 17-18: Searching
materials: Computer Algorithms (2/E) by Horowitz, Sahni, & Rajasekaran
